posts.zh:
dsh-session-manager 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 会话管理插件：删除（回收站可恢复或彻底清除）、恢复归档会话、活动统计、继续/暂停、打开日志目录、未读标记、新聊天中继续、工作区分组与排序、上下文压缩阈值设置。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-80855972e1cb60b35f1f.html
posts.en:
dsh-session-manager is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. DSH session manager: delete with trash/restore/purge, restore archived sessions, recent-activity stats, continue/pause, open log folder, unread markers, fork into a new chat, workspace grouping and sorting, context compaction threshold.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-80855972e1cb60b35f1f.html
